create_DEISMultistepScheduler: create a DEISMultistepScheduler instance with custom solver order and beta schedule for diffusion ODE solving
set_timesteps_DEISMultistepScheduler: set the discrete timesteps and noise schedule for a DEISMultistepScheduler before running inference
step_DEISMultistepScheduler: step the DEISMultistepScheduler to predict the sample from the previous timestep using multistep DEIS
convert_model_output_DEISMultistepSchedu: convert the diffusion model output to the format needed by the DEIS algorithm for the current prediction type
add_noise_DEISMultistepScheduler: add noise to original samples according to the DEIS scheduler noise schedule at specified timesteps
